/ Concerning the Eighteen great / Thrones of all the Fathers. /
There are nine thrones established for the great gods in the eternal realm. Another nine are appointed in this universe, the arena of conflict, and thus of loss and redemption. The last of these thrones is that upon which the apostle of a particular time sits; and Mani illustrates to his audience that he is now occupying it.
